blocks.content: Congratulations! You've completed the entire Whack-a-Mole project!
Take a moment to appreciate what you've accomplished.
You started with empty files and built a complete interactive browser game from scratch. That is real development work. Not a demo. Not a half finished experiment. A full game.

items: A professional start screen with clear instructions
Fully functional gameplay with random mole spawning
An end screen with final score and restart button
Organized JavaScript structured into logical sections

blocks.content: This is not just a prototype. It is a polished project you can confidently show to others.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
